sources.description: The Dodgers (80-54) look to bounce back after being swept by the Braves in Atlanta. They visit the Tigers (62-71) for a three-game series starting Friday night in Detroit. Tarik Skubal (8-7, 2.91 ERA, 0.95 WHIP) faces his former team for the first time at Comerica Park. Drew Anderson (4-5, 4.09 ERA, 1.29 WHIP) starts […]
